title: Service Level Agreement | Ironbark Hosting
description: Ironbark Hosting's SLA (effective July 1, 2026): Starter 99.9%, Business 99.95%, Enterprise 99.99% monthly uptime. Service credits apply when uptime falls below the commitment.
extra_snippets: Business plan: 99.95% monthly uptime. If monthly uptime falls below 99.95%, you receive a service credit of 10% of the monthly fee; below 99.0%, 25%.
Starter plan: 99.9% monthly uptime, no service credits.
Enterprise plan: 99.99% monthly uptime with credits of up to 50%.
content:
# Service Level Agreement

Effective July 1, 2026. Supersedes all previous versions.

| Plan | Monthly uptime commitment | Service credit |
|---|---|---|
| Starter | 99.9% | none |
| Business | 99.95% | 10% of the monthly fee below 99.95%; 25% below 99.0% |
| Enterprise | 99.99% | up to 50% |

Credits must be requested within 30 days.
